economic_hypothesis: A stock-specific decline becomes a tradable forced-inventory transfer only when a gap-down to a fresh low is completely absorbed by demand and at least one independent stock shows the same completed-session event. This tests local panic repair inside any market regime; it does not use the 2025 bull label to select trades.
unchanged_rules: The stock lost at least 10 percent over the preceding 20 exact completed sessions.
The completed signal opened at least 1 percent below the prior close and made a new five-session low.
Signal turnover was at least the prior-20 mean.
The signal closed at or above the prior high and in the upper 30 percent of its range, without closing at the upper price limit.
At least two independent stocks produced the same completed-session mother signal.
Enter at the first legal non-limit-up open in signal plus one through three; exit at +10 percent or the first legal sellable open after H20; charge 40 bps round trip.

evaluation.report: signals, completed trades, mean and median net return, mean holding sessions, target hit, severe loss, date concentration, and signal-month results
evaluation.user_gates: completed signals >50, mean net return >=4 percent, mean holding sessions <15
